mapper.sql: id, plan_no, agent_task_id, source_step_id, research_round, collection_task_id, species_id, base_id, objective, recommended_time_type, recommended_after_days, recommended_start_time, recommended_end_time, required_metrics_json, required_images_json, optional_items_json, completion_criteria_json, source_findings_json, rationale, uncertainty, priority, plan_source, prompt_version, model_name, status, version, create_time, update_time, confirm_time, expire_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_agent_collection_plan ( plan_no, agent_task_id, source_step_id, research_round, collection_task_id, species_id, base_id, objective, recommended_time_type, recommended_after_days, recommended_start_time, recommended_end_time, required_metrics_json, required_images_json, optional_items_json, completion_criteria_json, source_findings_json, rationale, uncertainty, priority, plan_source, prompt_version, model_name, status, version, create_time, update_time, confirm_time, expire_time ) VALUES ( #{planNo}, #{agentTaskId}, #{sourceStepId}, #{researchRound}, #{collectionTaskId}, #{speciesId}, #{baseId}, #{objective}, #{recommendedTimeType}, #{recommendedAfterDays}, #{recommendedStartTime}, #{recommendedEndTime}, #{requiredMetricsJson}, #{requiredImagesJson}, #{optionalItemsJson}, #{completionCriteriaJson}, #{sourceFindingsJson}, #{rationale}, #{uncertainty}, #{priority}, #{planSource}, #{promptVersion}, #{modelName}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{confirmTime}, #{expireTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM assistant_agent_collection_plan WHERE agent_task_id = #{agentTaskId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'PROPOSED', 'CONFIRMED') ORDER BY research_round DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE assistant_agent_collection_plan SET status = 'CANCELLED', update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE agent_task_id = #{agentTaskId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'PROPOSED')

UPDATE assistant_agent_collection_plan SET objective = #{plan.objective}, recommended_time_type = #{plan.recommendedTimeType}, recommended_after_days = #{plan.recommendedAfterDays}, recommended_start_time = #{plan.recommendedStartTime}, recommended_end_time = #{plan.recommendedEndTime}, required_metrics_json = #{plan.requiredMetricsJson}, required_images_json = #{plan.requiredImagesJson}, completion_criteria_json = #{plan.completionCriteriaJson}, rationale = #{plan.rationale}, plan_source = 'MANUAL_ADJUSTED', version = version + 1, update_time = #{plan.updateTime} WHERE id = #{plan.id} AND agent_task_id = #{plan.agentTaskId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'PROPOSED') AND version = #{expectedVersion}
